newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales confirmed on 800 slaughter steers and 300 heifers; 21,500 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,000 formulated and 1,100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 10 loads or 400 head of CME cattle.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00. Pen select, few choice 2-3 1100 lbs 69.00.
Wk to Date: 21,500 Week Ago: 74,600 Year Ago: 129,300
